subject.title: feat(ui): logo-scare lobster visits; drop the model-auth-expiring chip

question: Should the sidebar remove all early model-auth expiry notices, or should it retain them for providers whose expiring state requires user reauthentication?
rationale: The branch changes an existing auth-provider warning globally, while the supplied rationale establishes recurring noise only for a subset of continuously renewed OAuth credentials.

options.title: Narrow the suppression
options.body: Retain an early warning for credentials requiring user action and suppress it only when provider status proves automatic renewal.

options.title: Adopt expired-only alerts
options.body: Accept that users will receive no early-expiry signal and will be notified only once authentication is already expired.

recommendation.title: Narrow the suppression
recommendation.body: Retain an early warning for credentials requiring user action and suppress it only when provider status proves automatic renewal.

likelyOwner.reason: The submitted commits define both the user-facing warning policy and its implementation.
